role: Executable bounded-grid cross-check and exhaustive evaluator only after that cross-check passes; pinned Academy CTL remains the source-identity oracle.

release.claim: The upstream release removes the Preview label and officially releases ACES 2 support.

completeInstallInventory.policy: Every file below the generated installation root is sealed before execution; every reported imported module or cache file must be a matching member.

pythonRuntime.inventoryPolicy: every file below the CPython runtime root except Lib/site-packages, which isolated no-site execution never searches; pinned OCIO files are sealed separately. The complete aggregate therefore seals both the presence and absence of root search-path archives, path-configuration files, modules, packages, extensions, and DLLs before launch.
pythonRuntime.execution: Invoke the absolute executable with -I -S -B, insert only the sealed OCIO installation in the bootstrap, disable ambient PATH DLL loading, and use a constructed environment with no inherited PYTHON* variables.

executionPolicy.authoritySubset: Every sealed paired scalar diagnostic input plus frozen signed, neutral, clamp, seam, and hue/saturation anchors is run through both CTL and OCIO.
executionPolicy.exhaustiveUse: Only after bounded CTL-to-OCIO float and exact-Q8 parity passes, the sealed OCIO implementation may evaluate frame-derived probes, the exhaustive synthetic grid, and the 2,754 matched Bruneton rows.
executionPolicy.claimLimit: Passing the bounded authority subset authorizes this one sealed exhaustive decision; it does not establish universal interchangeability between CTL and OCIO.

acceptance: OCIO exhaustive evaluation is unauthorized until the bounded source-identity subset passes the declared CTL-to-OCIO float and exact-Q8 gates.
